candidate_hypotheses.falsifier: AICR + k8s-aibom + existing signature/policy composition shows equal drift coverage and comparable cost on blinded real workloads
Existing upstream timestamps, inventory history and deployment policies cover the same replay/rollback and drift cases without an extra event graph
No separately corroborated model execution evidence can be acquired; signatures alone only authenticate claims

limitations: This gate reviews official source documentation, not executed upstream tools.
A signed upstream assertion is not physical GPU execution attestation.
The same-input synthetic comparator cannot establish product differentiation.
User-controlled inputs cannot establish independent trust or customer demand.
